_note: Combat log templates (sim/combat_text.gd). Lines are built ONLY from the sim's computed result (tests/test_gore_text.gd checks every claim word against the strike record). Placeholders: {A}/{a} attacker label (capitalised/plain), {D}/{d} defender label, {W} weapon with its metal ('copper arming sword'), {WN} weapon type alone ('arming sword'), {V} verb 3rd person, {v} verb, {VW} 'with his <weapon>' (or 'with the shaft of his <weapon>'), {P} body part, {R} the worst layers ('shattering the skull and pulping the brain'), {ARM} armour piece, {THRU} the piece the blow went through, {BONE} the bone broken under a broken piece, {PIECE} what the attacker's weapon broke or bent on ("Grushnak's steel gauntlet"), {SH} shield, {DW} defender weapon, {his} the actor's possessive on hits, {ahis}/{ahe} attacker, {dhis}/{dhim}/{dhe} defender (the register's sex; 'its' for beasts). v0.014 (Douglas 22:51-22:57): DF-style vivid voice: the attacker, a strong verb, the armour, then the body, then the payoff; bigger results get bigger lines. 'mild' holds the Reduced-gore set (Settings > Gore): any group it has replaces the main one.
